with_sera.speaker: sera
with_sera.text: This is it. The Ninth Stair. They told us it was a Choir nest. That's a schoolroom. That's a cistern. Nobody here was singing.

choices.text: You held the torch. Knowing doesn't change the ash.
[Approval] Tell me what you need to do here.

seen_kind.speaker: sera
seen_kind.text: I didn't. I still lit it. Give me a minute here, then we move.

seen_hard.speaker: sera
seen_hard.text: No. It doesn't. That's why I'm standing in it.

mourned.speaker: sera
mourned.text: Names. I need the names. There's a roll in the cistern office if the damp left anything. Then I can stop calling it 'the village'.

alone.speaker: narrator
alone.text: A burned village on the third depth. A schoolroom, a cistern, an Ashfound purge-mark scorched into the gate. Someone should have been here to see it.

choices.text: Note the place and move on.

dead.speaker: narrator
dead.text: Sera's village. She never got to stand in it. You find the purge-mark on the gate and the roll of names in the cistern office, and you carry the roll out for her.
